disambiguation: Jujutsu Zero is a separate experience from Jujutsu Infinite, Jujutsu Shenanigans and Kaizen. All four are Jujutsu Kaisen inspired and their codes are frequently mixed up on competitor pages.
redeem_path: Launch Jujutsu Zero, work through the tutorial fight, then from the lobby open the Codes tab in the main menu, type the code into the Enter Code Here box and press Redeem.
redeem_requirements: The tutorial must be completed before the Codes option appears. New players who cannot find the button have almost always skipped this.

next_drop.pattern: The game is in beta and the developer is still adding techniques, raids and rewards, so codes track both update releases and like milestones. Like milestones arrive in 10,000 increments, which makes the next milestone code name predictable even when the timing is not.
watch: the Roblox experience page like count, which telegraphs the next milestone code

content_gap: Jujutsu Zero has no Trello board and no wiki, which is unusual for a game of its size and is confirmed by at least one major tracker. Everything a player needs about clans, cursed techniques and weapons currently lives in scattered Discord messages. A clans and techniques reference on this hub is the highest value non-codes page available for this game.
